frames: the frozen 64-frame nested set per view (gigahands_demo_cam_exp_0041_64frames_v1.csv.gz). No frame is chosen using the target, the ground truth or any model output.

frame_to_view_aggregation.secondary: IQR over the view's frames, for the features marked with_iqr
frame_to_view_aggregation.rule: target-independent; defined before any correlation was seen

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: grad_orientation_entropy
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: Shannon entropy of the gradient-orientation histogram (36 bins, magnitude-weighted), bits

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: long_line_count
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: segments longer than 10 % of the image diagonal

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: horizontal_line_fraction
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: fraction of segments within 15 deg of horizontal

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: vertical_line_fraction
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: fraction of segments within 15 deg of vertical

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: diagonal_line_fraction
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: fraction of segments that are neither

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: line_orientation_entropy
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: Shannon entropy of the length-weighted segment orientation histogram (18 bins over 180 deg), bits

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: dominant_line_orientation_strength
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: largest bin share of that histogram

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: vp_consensus_strength
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: largest share of segments consistent with a single RANSAC-like vanishing point (skipped if unstable)

F_SCENE_GEOM.name: orthogonal_line_support
F_SCENE_GEOM.definition: share of segment pairs whose orientations differ by 90 +/- 10 deg

F_IMAGE_GLOBAL.name: gray_std
F_IMAGE_GLOBAL.definition: standard deviation of the grayscale image

F_IMAGE_GLOBAL.name: gray_entropy
F_IMAGE_GLOBAL.definition: Shannon entropy of the 256-bin grayscale histogram, bits

F_IMAGE_GLOBAL.name: local_contrast
F_IMAGE_GLOBAL.definition: mean of the local std in 16x16 blocks

F_BORDER_SCENE.name: border_edge_density
F_BORDER_SCENE.definition: edge density in the outer 20 % border ring

F_BORDER_SCENE.name: border_line_count
F_BORDER_SCENE.definition: LSD segments whose midpoint lies in the border ring

F_BORDER_SCENE.name: border_long_line_count
F_BORDER_SCENE.definition: of those, longer than 10 % of the diagonal

F_BORDER_SCENE.name: border_grad_mag_mean
F_BORDER_SCENE.definition: mean gradient magnitude in the border ring

F_BORDER_SCENE.name: border_gray_std
F_BORDER_SCENE.definition: grayscale std in the border ring

F_MODEL_SELF.name: self_pred_focal_px
F_MODEL_SELF.definition: median predicted focal over the view (AnyCalib)

F_MODEL_SELF.name: self_pred_focal_log_iqr
F_MODEL_SELF.definition: IQR of log predicted focal within the view

F_MODEL_SELF.name: self_pred_k1_iqr
F_MODEL_SELF.definition: IQR of predicted k1 within the view

F_MODEL_SELF.name: self_pp_offset_norm
F_MODEL_SELF.definition: median |predicted principal point - image centre| / image diagonal

F_MODEL_SELF.name: self_pp_offset_iqr
F_MODEL_SELF.definition: IQR of that offset within the view

MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.name: disagree_abs_log_any_vs_geo
MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.definition: |log(f_AnyCalib / f_GeoCalib)| per frame, median over the view

MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.name: disagree_signed_log_any_vs_geo
MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.definition: signed log ratio, median over the view

MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.name: disagree_log_iqr
MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.definition: IQR of that signed log ratio within the view

deployability.F_SCENE_GEOM: deployable - classical OpenCV/NumPy on the RGB frame
deployability.F_IMAGE_GLOBAL: deployable - nuisance/scene-condition features, not a geometric causal claim
deployability.F_BORDER_SCENE: deployable - generic outer-region statistics. NOT a hand segmentation; no hand annotation, detector box or hand prediction is used anywhere
deployability.F_MODEL_SELF: deployable - the calibration model's own outputs. NOTE: includes the predicted focal, which is mathematically related to the target, so this group is always reported separately from the scene-only groups
deployability.MODEL_DISAGREEMENT: deployable - needs a second calibration model at deployment time; reported as its own diagnostic

forbidden_inputs: ground-truth focal, distortion, principal point or extrinsics
unstable_feature_policy: a feature whose implementation is not stable is recorded as FEATURE_SKIPPED_UNSTABLE rather than forced

determinism.note: OpenCV LSD and goodFeaturesToTrack are deterministic for a fixed input
